source_claim: AlphaEvolve's asynchronous controller and long-running island search require resume evidence for queued, running, and pending work, not only terminal drained-state snapshots.
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve writes a terminal runtime.history.controller_state snapshot for either the default single-process synchronous loop or the opt-in local asyncio candidate-evaluation controller. Async-enabled terminal snapshots embed the drained controller report, queue and worker lifecycle records, and deterministic admission telemetry. Finalization validates zero queued/running/pending work, checks the controller_budget_events.jsonl stream, exposes controller-state artifact inventory, and includes the same unsupported pending-work surfaces in full-runtime restore validation. It does not claim controller queue checkpoint schema support, queued proposal resume state, running evaluation resume state, in-flight LLM call resume state, pending archive admission resume state, partial-generation replay trace, async controller graph checkpoint, provider-output handoff replay, or end-to-end resumed trace proof.
